profile.quote-text: Courage does not always roar. Sometimes courage is the quiet voice at the end of the day saying, 'I will try again tomorrow.'
profile.expertise: Project Management;Technology Management;Digital Transformation;SME Industrial Operations

about.introduction: Dr. Puteri Fadzline is a dedicated academician and corporate strategy consultant with over 15 years of experience in higher education and industrial transformation frameworks.
about.teaching-philosophy: Her teaching philosophy revolves around industry-embedded experiential learning, ensuring business students gain real-world project delivery capabilities.
about.research-focus: Current research tracks focus primarily on digital readiness among small-to-medium enterprises (SMEs) adapting to automation and AI governance systems.
about.affiliations: Graduate Business School Network;Academy of Management;Project Management Institute (PMI) Malaysia Chapter;Malaysia AI Governance Society
